name: Business Process Type 1 Code
definition: Type of business process model used to carry out the transaction.

ISUP.name: Tripartite Central Matching
ISUP.definition: Specifies the processing of a transaction in a central matching utility model.

NISP.name: Not Covered By Investment Instructions
NISP.definition: Specifies the processing of a transaction in a local matching model.

PRAC.name: Pre Accepted
PRAC.definition: Transaction notice results from an agreement made out of a trading platform between two members (broker and intermediary) of an authorised entity.

RSAL.name: Reversal
RSAL.definition: Transaction notice reverses a previously sent and agreed transaction notice. If the reversal transaction notice is stated to serve as invoice:|o Fees and taxes contained in the transaction notice are considered as being in debit of the broker’s account and in credit of the intermediary’s account: it is a ‘credit invoice’;|o The broker will have to specify the original transaction notice reference;|o The reversal transaction notice will have the same direction (buy, sell) as the original transaction notice.

PROP.name: Own Account Trade Type
PROP.definition: Specifies the processing of a transaction in a own account trade type model.

THRU.name: Through Type
THRU.definition: Specifies the processing of a transaction in a through type model.

IDEL.name: Billateral Central Matching
IDEL.definition: Specifies the processing of a transaction in a billateral central matching model.

DPLX.name: Duplex Type
DPLX.definition: Specifies the processing of a transaction in a duplex type model.
